newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian U-Wood aborts Puncak buyout.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian U-Wood aborts Puncak buyout.

text.p: Plywood maker U-Wood Holdings Bhd said on Tuesday it had aborted its proposed buyout of a water supply concession holder and its stock would remain suspended pending further announcements.

U-Wood announced on October 2 that it had received government approval to acquire Puncak Niaga (M) Sdn Bhd, which holds the concession to supply water to Kuala Lumpur and neighbouring Selangor state under a privatisation scheme.

But U-Wood said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange that the plans "had been aborted as the vendors did not wish to extend further the conditional sale and purchase agreement which lapsed on 18 October 1996". It did not elaborate.
Puncak Niaga was awarded the privatisation project a year ago pending procedural approvals. Officials at the company could not be reached for comment.
U-Wood shares have been suspended since October 22, when they were last traded at 11.50 ringgit. The company requested the shares continue to be suspended pending further announcements.

A company official at U-Wood declined to say when the shares would be relisted. "It would not be any time soon," he told Reuters, adding that discussions were currently taking place within the company regarding the Puncak Niaga buyout.
